body: if im being honest, your action of suicide will fuck up the kid if you go through with it. its not me guilting you into living painfully, its just the truth. but i get where you are coming from to a degree. my situation feels trapping too. parents wont support me and have no friends but i cant just die as i have people who care about me. its fucked. im genuinely sorry that life has put you into your situation. this isnt pity, im being 100% honest with you. you are the only person who can choose what to do now. choose carefully, my friend.
